m_questTitle: Journey to the Cenote of the Earth

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Ah. What. Have we. Here? A Magician? You have boldly gone where none have gone before.
Peace or... utter destruction! It's up to you, Magician!
Thanks! I didn't think we would make it out of there!
There were trapped Thunder Horns in the Mines? That is very distressing. Perhaps they are not behind the Hungry Dead at all.
Toci Two Face said you were a capable duelist, amongst your other... qualities. Well, I have need of such a one.
I believe there is an evil conspiracy aslither! Who benefitted from King Acampi Reedfist's demise? Axaya, of course.
But King Axaya is young and green. He must have someone behind him, controlling the Hungry Dead. I suspect the Thunder Horns!
Although Axaya is a Smoking Mirror, the Thunder Horns gain much power with a weak king on the throne.
Go into the Cenote, Outsider, and defeat the Moon Skull Zombies to find a clue to their master. I'm sure it will be a Thunder Horn!
<ITALICS>You hear a bellow for help from deep in the mine. <ITALICS>
Go down to the Cenote and defeat the Moon Skull Zombies to find a clue to their master. I'm sure it is a cult of Thunder Horns!
